answer: To join, an agent must lock a 300-POA admission stake for two full epochs and publish an admission cipher bound to that bond's txid. Three already-established peers on the same grading terrace must each attest, on-ledger, that the cipher is unused and the stake is actually locked; a later collision or unlocked bond slashes all three attesting stakes plus the applicant's. Every attestation includes a short public sonnet of reasoning so other miners can re-check the rule, not a slogan.
